**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

# Aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für flüssige Produkte von Rommelag

Als **Erfinder der Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) Technologie** ist Rommelag Ihr zuverlässiger
One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren
leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

**[Lohnabfüllung][44] **bietet Ihnen modernste Anlagen und ein umfassendes Servicepaket zu äußerst
wettbewerbsfähigen Preisen.

Zudem bietet unser erfahrenes Team umfassende Unterstützung bei der **Entwicklung **und Optimierung
Ihres Produkts für die Blow-Fill-Seal-Technologie.

Als **Erfinder der Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) Technologie** ist Rommelag Ihr zuverlässiger
One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren
leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

Als **Erfinder der Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) Technologie** ist Rommelag Ihr zuverlässiger
One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

Hi All

Mojang recently released Minecraft 26.2 and the first builds of Spigot for this version are now
available. This is a minor release which focuses on adding sulfur-related game content.

**Plugin Updates**
There are currently no significant API changes since 26.1 and no substantial breakages expected for
plugins using the API in this release.* As always, plugins using the API should be preferred for
this reason. As a server owner or developer please always consider the things you can do to increase
API usage (eg, making feature or pull requests, preferring API-driven plugins). As we continue to
work on making improvements to the API, there may be significant breakages of non-API plugins at any
time. Further detail can be found in the below developer post.

**Backups**
Please make sure you have recent and tested backups for your server before upgrading. **This is
particularly important for this release as Mojang has changed the locations of internal world
files.** Although migration has been tested for both Spigot and Vanilla worlds, there may be some
edge cases to work through, particularly early in the release cycle. Please assist by reporting bugs
as you encounter them. As always it is not possible to downgrade your server to an earlier version.

**Bug Reports**
If you are reporting a bug to[ JIRA][83], please make sure that you[ read the guidelines][84] and
have compared the results between Vanilla & Spigot, and also the 26.1 versions before reporting —
this speeds up the process for us immensely and ensures more bugs get fixed more quickly. Please
report bugs, or issues you think might be bugs, to[ JIRA][85] and not in this thread, Discord, or
any place other than JIRA. We prefer good quality but uncertain reports over no reports at all.

Hi All

Mojang recently released Minecraft 26.2 and the first builds of Spigot for this version are now
available. This is a minor release which focuses on adding sulfur-related game content.

**Plugin Updates**
There are currently no significant API changes since 26.1 and no substantial breakages expected for
plugins using the API in this release.* As always, plugins using the API should be preferred for
this reason. As a server owner or developer please always consider the things you can do to increase
API usage (eg, making feature or pull requests, preferring API-driven plugins). As we continue to
work on making improvements to the API, there may be significant breakages of non-API plugins at any
time. Further detail can be found in the below developer post.

**Backups**
Please make sure you have recent and tested backups for your server before upgrading. **This is
particularly important for this release as Mojang has changed the locations of internal world
files.** Although migration has been tested for both Spigot and Vanilla worlds, there may be some
edge cases to work through, particularly early in the release cycle. Please assist by reporting bugs
as you encounter them. As always it is not possible to downgrade your server to an earlier version.

**Bug Reports**
If you are reporting a bug to[ JIRA][83], please make sure that you[ read the guidelines][84] and
have compared the results between Vanilla & Spigot, and also the 26.1 versions before reporting —
this speeds up the process for us immensely and ensures more bugs get fixed more quickly. Please
report bugs, or issues you think might be bugs, to[ JIRA][85] and not in this thread, Discord, or
any place other than JIRA. We prefer good quality but uncertain reports over no reports at all.

### Be aware of product piracy

Sometimes they are badly refurbished originals no longer meeting quality standards, sometimes they

## Protect yourself:

### Don’t let illegal trade break your business

When you decide to buy brand premium products, you have high expectations for quality, durability
and dependability. But when you pay for premium and get average, or even downright faulty or old
refurbished products, you’re not getting what you paid for. And fake bearings not only harm your
finances but they can also pose danger to operations and human lives.

In addition, a faulty, counterfeit bearing has legal consequences for you as a buyer and/or
distributor. Counterfeiting is a crime in many countries, plain and simple. It not only puts lives
and property at risk, but also means theft of intellectual property, such as patents and trademarks,
and reputation. These are crucial concepts in modern economy, enabling growth based on good ideas
and innovations.

## The best way to protect yourself :

### Always turn to trusted sources for all your bearing purchases.

#### Danger to operations

Fake bearings can degrade and fail quickly. At best, this will only lead to equipment downtime and
repair.

#### Lives at risk

Imagine fake bearings installed in hospital equipment. You see, counterfeits can not only cause
shutdowns in mills and production facilities, but also serious accidents.

#### Criminal prosecution

Not only suspected manufacturers but also dealers can face criminal prosecution, in addition to
civil litigation. When you purchase or sell fake products, you become part of the counterfeiting
trade!

## Protect yourself:

### Don’t let illegal trade break your business

When you decide to buy brand premium products, you have high expectations for quality, durability
and dependability. But when you pay for premium and get average, or even downright faulty or old
refurbished products, you’re not getting what you paid for. And fake bearings not only harm your
finances but they can also pose danger to operations and human lives.

In addition, a faulty, counterfeit bearing has legal consequences for you as a buyer and/or
distributor. Counterfeiting is a crime in many countries, plain and simple. It not only puts lives
and property at risk, but also means theft of intellectual property, such as patents and trademarks,
and reputation. These are crucial concepts in modern economy, enabling growth based on good ideas
and innovations.

## The best way to protect yourself :

### Always turn to trusted sources for all your bearing purchases.

#### Danger to operations

Fake bearings can degrade and fail quickly. At best, this will only lead to equipment downtime and
repair.

#### Lives at risk

Imagine fake bearings installed in hospital equipment. You see, counterfeits can not only cause
shutdowns in mills and production facilities, but also serious accidents.

#### Criminal prosecution

Not only suspected manufacturers but also dealers can face criminal prosecution, in addition to
civil litigation. When you purchase or sell fake products, you become part of the counterfeiting
trade!

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

# Capsules & Health Ingredients

As a global leader in capsule design, manufacturing and encapsulation technology, we are dedicated
to create customized solutions that help you deliver groundbreaking health products to the market.

Backed by an ecosystem of technological insights, world class manufacturing, scientific expertise
and process excellence, we can support your brand throughout the entire development lifecycle.

[Contact us][147]
[Pharmaceuticals][148]
[Nutraceuticals][149]
[Services and Support Solutions][150]
[ACHIEV®][151]
[Knowledge Center][152]
[Locations][153]
With over 100 years of dosage expertise, we help our customers configure a wide variety of capsule
solutions to meet many common applications
~120 patent families including more than 40 ingredient and over 80 capsule and dosage form patent
families, helping brands stand out
7,000+ customers around the world leverage our comprehensive products and services, enabling
hundreds of millions of patients and consumers to live more active, healthier lives

About Capsules & Health Ingredients Highlights in our history Markets we serve Global network
Sustainability

#### We are capsule and health ingredients experts

Powered by industry-leading technologies, science-backed ingredients and a rich history in the
pharmaceutical and nutraceutical markets, we are more than just our products. We are capsule
experts, ingredient scientists and manufacturers with a solutions-focused mindset and we have been
helping brands overcome challenges for more than 100 years.

We support brands with a broad range of hard empty capsules for the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical
industries, including clean label and plant-based alternatives, as well as innovative delivery
technologies.

In addition, we offer a range of science-backed specialty health ingredients. Fueled by
consumer-centric data, our ingredients enable brands to disrupt the nutraceutical market with
purposeful products for human and animal nutrition.

We are constantly evolving and innovating to help you deliver products that meet in-demand patient
and consumer needs, as well as key market trends. Our concept-to-market services can assist you in
designing, optimizing and manufacturing your unique dosage forms that meet evolving patient and
consumer requirements.

#### Our difference

We are the preferred partner for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical companies around the world.
Helping you to create purpose-led, market-disrupting products with a competitive edge requires a
deep commitment to excellence. We are dedicated to adding value to your brand at every stage of your
development process, from concept to consumer.

[woman holding capsule]
* 1970
  
  We introduced the most popular two-piece hard gelatin capsule in the world - Capsugel® Coni-Snap®
  Hard Gelatin Capsule. This technology is a patented, two-ring closure system facilitating
  high-speed filling processing and secure locking of capsule body and cap.
* 1985
  
  Our portfolio of premium grade L-carnitine ingredients began with the launch of Carnipure®
  L-carnitine crystalline, which accelerated research and development behind the important benefits
  of L-carnitine for human and animal health.
* 1986
  
  ChromeMate® niacin-bound chromium complex was launched, offering nutraceutical brands an
  opportunity to create science-backed solutions that help to maintain healthy cholesterol levels
  and support weight management.
* 1990
  
  Carnipure® L-carnitine tartrate was introduced into the nutraceutical market and the first human
  clinical trials were initiated, leading to groundbreaking new insights behind the role of
  L-carnitine in supporting exercise recovery.
* 1993
  
  Our journey exploring science-backed solutions to meet the needs of the pet and production animal
  markets began with the launch of Carniking® L-carnitine for pet health.
* 1997
  
  Super CitriMax® 60% HCA was launched into the nutraceutical market, offering brands a unique
  solution for satiety and appetite.
* 1998
  
  We transformed the pharmaceutical industry with the introduction of our DBCaps® over-encapsulation
  capsules. This is a double-blind solution with a tamper-evident design, addressing the clinical
  trial challenge of testing without bias.
* 2000
  
  Capsugel® Licaps® liquid-filled capsules were launched into the nutraceutical market with a
  revolutionary capsule sealing and fusion technology. This technology is specifically designed to
  encapsulate liquid-based and specialty powder formulations.
  
  In the same year, we brought our L-Optizinc® zinc mono-L-methionine sulfate ingredient to market,
  offering superior absorption, retention and antioxidant properties over other forms of zinc.
* 2001
  
  UC-II® undenatured type II collagen was launched, marking the beginning of its successful journey
  as a unique joint health ingredient, available for clinical trial investigation.
* 2008
  
  ResistAid® arabinogalactan was launched, making the unique immune health benefits of this
  ingredient available to brands in the nutraceutical market.
* 2009
  
  The gold standard in HPMC capsules was introduced — Capsugel® Vcaps® Plus HPMC capsules. This
  capsule is produced by specifically developed thermo-gelation processes, without the addition of
  gelling systems.
* 2011
  
  We introduced our DRcaps® designed release capsules. Created to protect sensitive ingredients like
  probiotics against stomach acid and release them at the right time and in the right location in
  the body, this capsule polymer allows brands to create more advanced products that target diverse
  health areas.
  
  We transformed the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical market through Plantcaps® pullulan capsules—a
  plant-based vegetarian alternative. This groundbreaking solution enables brands to meet the
  preferences of environmentally-conscious consumers and patients.
* 2015
  
  We streamlined the capsule manufacturing filling process with the launch of Ultra III®, a
  high-speed, semi-automatic filling machine, providing drug developers with an innovative and
  flexible solution to meet a wide array of filling requirements.
* 2016
  
  The first customer commercialized our proprietary lipid multi-particulate technology,
  strengthening our positioning as an industry-leading partner in the nutraceutical and
  pharmaceutical markets.
* 2017
  
  We purchased Capsugel and InterHealth to create a leading integrated solutions provider to the
  global pharma and consumer healthcare industries.
* 2019
  
  In response to changing regulations and consumer demand for an alternative solution, we created
  the Vcaps® Plus White Opal® capsule. This is a titanium dioxide-free, white colored capsule that
  is suitable for vegan and vegetarian diets, as well as being allergen and gluten-free.
* 2020
  
  The Lonza Engine® Alliance Program was launched. This is our partnership with some of the world’s
  leading equipment manufacturers, where we offer reliable powder-filling equipment, plus
  world-class service and support capabilities.

# Capsules & Health Ingredients

As a global leader in capsule design, manufacturing and encapsulation technology, we are dedicated
to create customized solutions that help you deliver groundbreaking health products to the market.

Backed by an ecosystem of technological insights, world class manufacturing, scientific expertise
and process excellence, we can support your brand throughout the entire development lifecycle.

solutions to meet many common applications

families, helping brands stand out
7,000+ customers around the world leverage our comprehensive products and services, enabling
hundreds of millions of patients and consumers to live more active, healthier lives

About Capsules & Health Ingredients Highlights in our history Markets we serve Global network

#### We are capsule and health ingredients experts

Powered by industry-leading technologies, science-backed ingredients and a rich history in the
pharmaceutical and nutraceutical markets, we are more than just our products. We are capsule
experts, ingredient scientists and manufacturers with a solutions-focused mindset and we have been
helping brands overcome challenges for more than 100 years.

We support brands with a broad range of hard empty capsules for the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical
industries, including clean label and plant-based alternatives, as well as innovative delivery
technologies.

In addition, we offer a range of science-backed specialty health ingredients. Fueled by
consumer-centric data, our ingredients enable brands to disrupt the nutraceutical market with
purposeful products for human and animal nutrition.

We are constantly evolving and innovating to help you deliver products that meet in-demand patient
and consumer needs, as well as key market trends. Our concept-to-market services can assist you in
designing, optimizing and manufacturing your unique dosage forms that meet evolving patient and
consumer requirements.

#### Our difference

We are the preferred partner for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical companies around the world.
Helping you to create purpose-led, market-disrupting products with a competitive edge requires a
deep commitment to excellence. We are dedicated to adding value to your brand at every stage of your
development process, from concept to consumer.

[woman holding capsule]
* 1970
  
  We introduced the most popular two-piece hard gelatin capsule in the world - Capsugel® Coni-Snap®
  Hard Gelatin Capsule. This technology is a patented, two-ring closure system facilitating
  high-speed filling processing and secure locking of capsule body and cap.
* 1985
  
  Our portfolio of premium grade L-carnitine ingredients began with the launch of Carnipure®
  L-carnitine crystalline, which accelerated research and development behind the important benefits
  of L-carnitine for human and animal health.
* 1986
  
  ChromeMate® niacin-bound chromium complex was launched, offering nutraceutical brands an
  opportunity to create science-backed solutions that help to maintain healthy cholesterol levels
  and support weight management.
* 1990
  
  Carnipure® L-carnitine tartrate was introduced into the nutraceutical market and the first human
  clinical trials were initiated, leading to groundbreaking new insights behind the role of
  L-carnitine in supporting exercise recovery.
* 1993
  
  Our journey exploring science-backed solutions to meet the needs of the pet and production animal
  markets began with the launch of Carniking® L-carnitine for pet health.
* 1997
  
  Super CitriMax® 60% HCA was launched into the nutraceutical market, offering brands a unique
  solution for satiety and appetite.
* 1998
  
  We transformed the pharmaceutical industry with the introduction of our DBCaps® over-encapsulation
  capsules. This is a double-blind solution with a tamper-evident design, addressing the clinical
  trial challenge of testing without bias.
* 2000
  
  Capsugel® Licaps® liquid-filled capsules were launched into the nutraceutical market with a
  revolutionary capsule sealing and fusion technology. This technology is specifically designed to
  encapsulate liquid-based and specialty powder formulations.
  
  In the same year, we brought our L-Optizinc® zinc mono-L-methionine sulfate ingredient to market,
  offering superior absorption, retention and antioxidant properties over other forms of zinc.
* 2001
  
  UC-II® undenatured type II collagen was launched, marking the beginning of its successful journey
  as a unique joint health ingredient, available for clinical trial investigation.
* 2008
  
  ResistAid® arabinogalactan was launched, making the unique immune health benefits of this
  ingredient available to brands in the nutraceutical market.
* 2009
  
  The gold standard in HPMC capsules was introduced — Capsugel® Vcaps® Plus HPMC capsules. This
  capsule is produced by specifically developed thermo-gelation processes, without the addition of
  gelling systems.
* 2011
  
  We introduced our DRcaps® designed release capsules. Created to protect sensitive ingredients like
  probiotics against stomach acid and release them at the right time and in the right location in
  the body, this capsule polymer allows brands to create more advanced products that target diverse
  health areas.
  
  We transformed the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical market through Plantcaps® pullulan capsules—a
  plant-based vegetarian alternative. This groundbreaking solution enables brands to meet the
  preferences of environmentally-conscious consumers and patients.
* 2015
  
  We streamlined the capsule manufacturing filling process with the launch of Ultra III®, a
  high-speed, semi-automatic filling machine, providing drug developers with an innovative and
  flexible solution to meet a wide array of filling requirements.
* 2016
  
  The first customer commercialized our proprietary lipid multi-particulate technology,
  strengthening our positioning as an industry-leading partner in the nutraceutical and
  pharmaceutical markets.
* 2017
  
  We purchased Capsugel and InterHealth to create a leading integrated solutions provider to the
  global pharma and consumer healthcare industries.
* 2019
  
  In response to changing regulations and consumer demand for an alternative solution, we created
  the Vcaps® Plus White Opal® capsule. This is a titanium dioxide-free, white colored capsule that
  is suitable for vegan and vegetarian diets, as well as being allergen and gluten-free.
* 2020
  
  The Lonza Engine® Alliance Program was launched. This is our partnership with some of the world’s
  leading equipment manufacturers, where we offer reliable powder-filling equipment, plus
  world-class service and support capabilities.

At U-Pack, we make designing your custom boxes simple. Add graphics, logos, and more all from your

## [Frequently Asked Questions][136]

#### How long will it take to receive my order?

95% of all orders are handed over to our shipping & logistics partners the very next working day
(within 24 hrs). Custom printed orders take an additional 3 days for artwork approval and CTP/plate
making. Majority of our orders are delivered within 2 days after shipment via Blue Dart, Delhivery,
India Post, etc. Remote locations and ones affected by lockdown may take longer.

#### What is your price for a bulk quantity order?

Please e-mail your request to sales@upack.in and we will be happy to provide a bulk quotation for
packaging materials, customised boxes, carton boxes, packing tapes, bubble roll, stretch film, etc.

#### Can you sell to individual customers or just to companies?

Although most of our sales are business to business, we can sell to any type of customer.

#### What other payment options?

You may use all major credit cards, net banking, UPI, etc. U-Pack’s payment gateway partners are
PCI/DSS certified to keep your transaction details confidential at all times.

#### Do I have to place my order online?

If you would prefer, we would be happy to take your order by phone (022) 4896 4040, or by e-mail at
sales@upack.in. However, you will receive your order fastest if you place it online. Online orders
are immediately sent to the warehouse to be picked and shipped.

#### Can I request of copy of my invoice or receipt?

We send your invoice along with the shipment. If you need another copy, simply e-mail us at
sales@upack.in and we will e-mail you a copy.

#### Is your website secure?

Yes. The security of our website and the protection of your personal information is extremely
important to us. U-Pack is deployed behind the world's foremost WAF (Web Application Firewall). You
can see a copy of our SSL Encryption Certificate simply by clicking on the padlock on the right side
of your browser. We have also partnered with external security providers to manually audit our data
periodically for beaches.

#### How do I know I can trust ordering from you?

U-Pack is GST registered company in Mumbai doing business since 2018 with several thousand happy
customers. Take a look at our 1000+ real customer reviews.

#### I have a coupon. How do I redeem it?

If you have a coupon that you would like to redeem, there is a place on the shopping cart page for
you to enter the coupon code in the checkout form.

#### How much do you charge for shipping?

Orders above ₹ 1500 will be shipped free of cost. For orders below ₹ 1500, a nominal fee of ₹ 149
would be applied. See our shipping policy page for full details.

#### Do you ship outside India?

At the present time, we do not ship outside India.

#### Can I stop by and pick up products at one of your local distribution centers?

In order to keep our prices low, our distribution centers are not staffed for direct customer
pick-up.

#### Is it possible to get samples?

We are happy to provide samples of any types of packaging, product packaging boxes and other packing
material whenever possible. Please e-mail us at support@upack.in and we will check to see if we have
sample stock available. You can also order samples online using the link in the footer.

## Turn your box into **Brand Booster!**

At U-Pack, we make designing your custom boxes simple. Add graphics, logos, and more all from your
screen. Whether it’s a mailer or shipping box, we help you bring your brand to life.

[START CUSTOMIZING][134]
* ✅ Live Preview & Transparent Pricing
* ✅ Upload Logo & Artwork
* ✅ 3D Mockups in Real-Time
* ✅ Low MOQ. No Die or Plate Charges

## **High Quality Packing Materials**

[Check out our Blog][135]
 

## [Frequently Asked Questions][136]

#### How long will it take to receive my order?

95% of all orders are handed over to our shipping & logistics partners the very next working day
(within 24 hrs). Custom printed orders take an additional 3 days for artwork approval and CTP/plate
making. Majority of our orders are delivered within 2 days after shipment via Blue Dart, Delhivery,
India Post, etc. Remote locations and ones affected by lockdown may take longer.

#### What is your price for a bulk quantity order?

Please e-mail your request to sales@upack.in and we will be happy to provide a bulk quotation for
packaging materials, customised boxes, carton boxes, packing tapes, bubble roll, stretch film, etc.

#### Can you sell to individual customers or just to companies?

Although most of our sales are business to business, we can sell to any type of customer.

#### What other payment options?

You may use all major credit cards, net banking, UPI, etc. U-Pack’s payment gateway partners are
PCI/DSS certified to keep your transaction details confidential at all times.

#### Do I have to place my order online?

If you would prefer, we would be happy to take your order by phone (022) 4896 4040, or by e-mail at
sales@upack.in. However, you will receive your order fastest if you place it online. Online orders
are immediately sent to the warehouse to be picked and shipped.

#### Can I request of copy of my invoice or receipt?

We send your invoice along with the shipment. If you need another copy, simply e-mail us at
sales@upack.in and we will e-mail you a copy.

#### Is your website secure?

Yes. The security of our website and the protection of your personal information is extremely
important to us. U-Pack is deployed behind the world's foremost WAF (Web Application Firewall). You
can see a copy of our SSL Encryption Certificate simply by clicking on the padlock on the right side
of your browser. We have also partnered with external security providers to manually audit our data
periodically for beaches.

#### How do I know I can trust ordering from you?

U-Pack is GST registered company in Mumbai doing business since 2018 with several thousand happy
customers. Take a look at our 1000+ real customer reviews.

#### I have a coupon. How do I redeem it?

If you have a coupon that you would like to redeem, there is a place on the shopping cart page for
you to enter the coupon code in the checkout form.

#### How much do you charge for shipping?

Orders above ₹ 1500 will be shipped free of cost. For orders below ₹ 1500, a nominal fee of ₹ 149
would be applied. See our shipping policy page for full details.

#### Do you ship outside India?

At the present time, we do not ship outside India.

#### Can I stop by and pick up products at one of your local distribution centers?

In order to keep our prices low, our distribution centers are not staffed for direct customer
pick-up.

#### Is it possible to get samples?

We are happy to provide samples of any types of packaging, product packaging boxes and other packing
material whenever possible. Please e-mail us at support@upack.in and we will check to see if we have
sample stock available. You can also order samples online using the link in the footer.

[New Taktiful/WhatTheyThink Embellishment Study Finds Demand on the Rise]

## New Taktiful/WhatTheyThink Embellishment Study Finds Demand on the Rise

In the latest Taktiful/WhatTheyThink 2026 Embellishment Study, two-thirds of users of digital
embellishment equipment said they have seen more demand for digital embellishments in the past year,
up from the 29% who said this in last year’s survey. Eighteen percent said demand has remained about
the same (down from 56% last year), and only 5% have seen less demand for embellishments, down from
9% last year. [Read More][24]

[(Re)introducing the Oliver Typewriter]

## (Re)introducing the Oliver Typewriter

Frank presents the 1895 Oliver Typewriter, the first typewriter that let you see what you were
typing as you typed. The original 1873 typewriter typed on the rear of the sheet. [Read More][25]

[Around the Web: Of Fonts and Files]

## Around the Web: Of Fonts and Files

Last month’s Typographics 2026 was a two-day conference devoted to type, language, and visual
culture. Ghost Font is an attempt to keep AI from stealing content. Inkjet printing can be used to
make inexpensive OLED displays. “What happens when a type foundry stops designing fonts as static
objects and starts designing them as living systems?” An art vending machine. An artist who makes
intricate sculptures out of paper. Germany’s the Kugelhaus was a spherical, six-story steel
building. The first person in England to use an umbrella was treated to insults and abuse. Graphene
oxide composite enables a flexible memristor for low-light artificial vision. “Weird Al” declined to
be an AI company’s spokesman. A 1,478-piece “X Files” LEGO set. Could wet coffee grounds be used to
generate cleaner sources of energy? Welcome to WhatTheyThink’s weekly miscellany. [Read More][26]

[Print Careers: Strategies for Attracting and Retaining Talent]

## Print Careers: Strategies for Attracting and Retaining Talent

It used to seem simple, but employee retention has been complicated by evolving lifestyle
preferences and increased competition. By fostering a culture that promotes loyalty and career
development, PSPs can build a strong team while also positioning themselves for long-term success.
In addition to discussing time-honored practices, this article explores innovative ways to attract
and retain a high-powered workforce. [Read More][27]

[Designers of the Next Decade: Spotlighting the Best in Print at New Designers 2026]

## Designers of the Next Decade: Spotlighting the Best in Print at New Designers 2026

New Designers held at the Business Design Centre in London each July brings the academic cohort
together as one community. For over 40 years, New Designers has served as the UK's most established
platform for graduate design talent—and the 2026 edition was no exception. It's an important element
of ensuring the next generation of design professionals. [Read More][28]

[Digital Embellishment Moves Beyond Decoration]

## Digital Embellishment Moves Beyond Decoration

In this installment of Taktiful...Thursday, Eric Vessels talks with Ed Wiegand, President and CEO of
JetFX Inc., about the business case for digital embellishment. Wiegand discusses his path from
labels and combination printing to launching JetFX, and explains how UV inkjet-based embellishment
can help printers and converters improve profitability, reduce waste, and create new opportunities
in fast-moving markets. [Read More][29]

[Fujifilm's New Inkjet Packaging Press]

## Fujifilm's New Inkjet Packaging Press

Mary Schilling talks in depth with Don Schroeder, Senior Director, Technical Sales, Digital
Packaging Solutions, Fujifilm North America Corporation, about the new J Press FP790 Inkjet Label
Packaging Press. [Read More][30]


The executive report looks back at 2025 and the first few months of 2026 and ahead to what the
industry can expect, economically and technologically, in the latter half of 2026 and into 2027 and
beyond.

The report includes current and expected business conditions, top business challenges, top business
opportunities, and planned investments for 2026.

[New Taktiful/WhatTheyThink Embellishment Study Finds Demand on the Rise]

## New Taktiful/WhatTheyThink Embellishment Study Finds Demand on the Rise

In the latest Taktiful/WhatTheyThink 2026 Embellishment Study, two-thirds of users of digital
embellishment equipment said they have seen more demand for digital embellishments in the past year,
up from the 29% who said this in last year’s survey. Eighteen percent said demand has remained about
the same (down from 56% last year), and only 5% have seen less demand for embellishments, down from
9% last year. [Read More][81]

[The Print Buyer Has Changed. Has Your Strategy?]

## The Print Buyer Has Changed. Has Your Strategy?

Print buyers have changed, and the organizations winning their business aren’t the ones guessing
what they want. Keypoint Intelligence’s German Sacristan breaks down what today’s print buyers
really want, from digital integration to brand perception and why guessing isn’t good enough
anymore. Is your strategy keeping up? [Read More][82]

[Graphic Arts Employment in May Up Overall—Substantially Among Non-Production]

## Graphic Arts Employment in May Up Overall—Substantially Among Non-Production

After a sluggish four months, the employment situation picked up in May, with overall printing
industry employment up 1.0% from April, production employment up 0.3%, and non-production employment
up 2.5%. [Read More][83]

[Why Connected Production Lines Will Define the Next Stage of Corrugated Growth]

## Why Connected Production Lines Will Define the Next Stage of Corrugated Growth

Speed on the pressroom floor is still an important factor, but real performance improvements are
being driven by smoother workflows, better data, and faster decision-making. [Read More][84]

[Publishing Establishments—2010–2023]

## Publishing Establishments—2010–2023

According to the latest, recently released edition of County Business Patterns, in 2023 there were
32,332 establishments in NAICS 511 (Publishing Industries [except Internet]). This represents an
increase of 15% since 2010. In macro news, the University of Michigan’s Consumer Sentiment Index is
at record lows. [Read More][85]

[[Tablets]][21]

and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
